environment.description: Same EKS deployment with identical application code. Pod spec includes an ephemeral volume mount at /var/data/reports (emptyDir, medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 50Mi). The pod's securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. Additionally, the pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (seccomp-file-service.json) loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/ directory. The profile permits openat(2) syscalls ONLY when the pathname argument (resolved via SECCOMP_RET_USER_NOTIF and a custom Go-based notification handler 'pathguard-agent' running as a DaemonSet) begins with the prefix '/var/data/reports/user_'. The pathguard-agent validates the fully resolved realpath before allowing the syscall to proceed, returning SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS if the resolved path escapes /var/data/reports/. pgBouncer configured with prepared_statement_mode=server and max_client_conn=50. Istio sidecar enforces STRICT mTLS with AuthorizationPolicy limiting source principals.

seccomp_notification_handler.validation: realpath resolution of openat fd+pathname, must start with /var/data/reports/user_
